annotations.identity_key_window: inside — evaluated at 1788965023 (2026-09-09T14:43:43.000Z) against key insight-oracle-safety-sample [validFrom 1788393600 (2026-09-03T00:00:00.000Z), validUntil open]
annotations.precedence: signed_before_block (asserted by signer, unanchored) — preTradeSignedAt 1788964992 is 30s before executedAt 1788965022. Ordering itself is not_checked: that a gate existed BEFORE the trade cannot be established from these bytes. Signature timestamps are package metadata and `checkedAt` is a signed field the signer chooses. Anchoring the gate uid before the trade transaction is what would close it.
annotations.observations: not_checked — participantCount, sourceGroupCount, independenceSatisfied, the consensus price's provenance and mevRiskBps are issuer claims; nothing in these bytes tests them.
